# `state/time/SimulationClock.js`

> **Source:** `engine/state/time/SimulationClock.js`

state/time/SimulationClock.js — simulation time (spec §9 "Simulation time").  Simulation time is a domain-specific relationship between simulated changes (physics steps, biological cycles, world epochs, oscillator phases). There may be MANY simulation clocks and NO universal model clock — each advances independently. Simulation clocks are distinct from causal time (dependencies) and operational time (deadlines/leases); they never establish authority.  Advancing is deterministic: the same sequence of steps yields the same tick, which is required for deterministic replay (rule 66/68).

### `class SimulationClockSet`

A set of independent simulation clocks. Each domain advances on its own; there is deliberately no method to advance them all in lockstep to a global time.

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor()` |  |

| `snapshot` | `snapshot()` | Snapshot of every clock's current tick — clocks may differ; that's expected. |
| `size` | `get size()` |  |
